tall|高的,strong|强壮的,quiet|安静的,kind|友善的,thin|瘦的,helpful|乐于助人的,popular|受欢迎的,clever|聪明的,athletic|擅长运动的,bald|秃头的,curly hair|卷发,straight hair|直发,wavy hair|波浪形头发
She is helpful. She has long hair.
说出工作地点，再说职业需要的爱好与能力。
farmer|农民,nurse|护士,doctor|医生,scientist|科学家,architect|建筑师,musician|音乐家,paramedic|急救医护人员,designer|设计师,PE teacher|体育老师,firefighter|消防员,police officer|警察,factory worker|工厂工人,palaeontologist|古生物学家
I want to be a firefighter because I want to help people.
把地点和可以做的事情一起记忆。
hospital|医院,library|图书馆,playground|操场,museum|博物馆,bakery|面包店,theatre|剧院,post office|邮局,square|广场,clock tower|钟楼,roundabout|环岛,traffic lights|交通信号灯,crossroad|十字路口,T-junction|丁字路口,supermarket|超市
There is a library. I read books there.

clean the room|打扫房间,water the plants|给植物浇水,feed the pet|喂宠物,do the dishes|洗碗,sweep the floor|扫地,make breakfast|做早餐,walk the dog|遛狗,make a gift|做礼物,look after|照顾
按种植顺序记忆：dig → plant → water → weed → pick。
pumpkin|南瓜,lettuce|生菜,cucumber|黄瓜,cabbage|卷心菜,onion|洋葱,eggplant|茄子,green beans|四季豆,zucchini|西葫芦,tomato|番茄,dig|挖,plant|种植,weed|除草,pick|采摘
We have to water the garden three times a week.
grammar: is-has
is 与 has
W2 / W6
is + 形容词；has + 名词（身体特征）。否定：is not / doesn’t have。

She is tall. → She is not tall.
He has short hair. → He doesn’t have long hair.
介绍朋友：写一句 is 和一句 has。
frequency
习惯与频率
W2 / W6 · Mid 2
always → often → sometimes → never。he / she 后的实义动词通常加 -s；次数用 once / twice / three times。

She often helps me.
How often do you water the garden?
Three times a week.
用 often 描述朋友每周做的事。
plans
现在进行时与未来计划
W3 / W6
am / is / are + 动词-ing 可描述正在发生的动作（如 now）。加上 tomorrow / next week 等未来时间，也可表示已安排的计划。

I am reading a story now.
I am visiting my grandparents tomorrow.
Are you coming to school next week?
What are you doing on Monday?
将 I am cleaning my room tomorrow. 改为否定句。
compare
比较级：发现不同
Our World U1 · Mid 2
常见变化：tall → taller；big → bigger；friendly → friendlier；beautiful → more beautiful；good → better；bad → worse。比较时用 than。

The girl is faster than the boy.
Which is smaller, the dog or the cat?
用 taller than 比较两个人。
there
There is / There are
W7 / W8
单数用 There is，多数用 There are。提问时把 is / are 移到前面。

There is a park in my community.
There are two shops.
Is there a library?
介绍社区中的一个地点和多个地点。
likes
爱好、能力与责任
W4 · Mid 2
like / be good at 后可接名词或动词-ing。have to 表示必须，he / she 用 has to。would like to 后接动词原形。

I like painting. I’m good at art.
She has to feed the pet.
I’d like to play games.
用 like 和 good at 说明你的理想职业。
present-simple
一般现在时与第三人称单数
期中汇编 · 时态综合 1
描述经常发生的事用一般现在时。I / you / we / they 后用动词原形；he / she / it 后通常加 -s 或 -es。否定与提问用 does 时，后面的动词恢复原形。

He helps his family every day.
He does not help at night.
Does he help his family? Yes, he does.
She goes to school on Mondays.
把 They water the plants every day. 改写为以 She 开头的句子，再改成否定句。
past-simple
一般过去时：did / was / were
期中汇编 · 时态综合 4
在故事和日记中，yesterday / last week 提示已经发生的事。I / he / she / it 常用 was，you / we / they 用 were。实义动词的过去式有规则与不规则变化；did / didn’t 后接动词原形。

I was tired yesterday. We were happy.
He helped his family last Saturday.
What did he do? He made breakfast.
He didn’t go to school that day.
在 A Busy Saturday 中圈出过去式，再用 What did Jack do? 提问并回答。
expressions: friend
介绍我的朋友
W2 · Mid 2
名字 → 外貌 → 性格 → 爱好 → 我们一起做的事。

My best friend is Lily.
She is kind and quiet.
She has long hair.
We often read books together.
介绍一个朋友，至少说 5 句。
directions
问路与指路
W7 / W8
先说沿哪条路走，再说在哪转弯，最后说目的地的位置。

Where is the library?
Go along Main Street.
Take the first right.
It’s on your left, opposite the park.
画一个小地图，给家人指路。
dream
我的理想职业
W4 · Mid 2
I want to be… + because…；给出爱好、能力和帮助他人的理由。

I want to be a teacher.
I like working with children.
I’m good at English.
I want to help children learn.
选择一个职业，说明三个理由。
weekend
我的周末计划
W3 · 期中口语
开头介绍主题，中间讲计划与时间，最后用一句话收尾。

Here are my plans for this weekend.
I’m visiting my grandparents on Saturday.
I’m not going to school on Sunday.
These are my weekend plans.
说 8 句：开头 + 6 句内容 + 结尾。
story-retelling
用正确时态复述故事
期中汇编 · Kids’ Stories S3–S5
先找主要人物、事件和结果，再按顺序复述。用 what / when / where / how / why 寻找文本证据；原文没说的时间或地点不要猜。描述习惯用现在时，讲已发生的事件用过去时。

Today I want to tell you the story “A Lion and a Mouse”.
First, … Then, … Finally, …
From the story, I learn that little friends can be great friends.
从 My Dad、I Want to Be a Firefighter、A Lion and a Mouse 中选一篇，说出大意、两个细节和你的理解。
topic-writing
话题说写：从审题到检查
期中汇编 · Topic
先确定主题和时间，再写开头、内容、结尾。按主题选择比较级、there be、have to、频率表达和第三人称单数；写完检查拼写、完整句、大小写和标点。下方是本站练习框架。

Opening: Introduce your topic.
Details: Give examples in a clear order.
Ending: Say how you feel or what you learn.
Check: tense → verb forms → spelling → punctuation.
选择朋友、家庭或菜园主题，先口述再写一小段。根据实际主题使用学过的句型，不必把所有语法塞进同一篇。
